  PROBLEM: The changelog claims "0" extra API calls because the one comment listing is "read once and reused for the hand-off check." That statement is true for the issue's case (hold on a fixer head, or a hand-off for the same head) but not for a `claude/implement-plan-*` PR that carries a blocking label (`ai:review-blocked`, `ai:review-autofix-failed`, `ai:needs-human`) with no hold.
  WHY: Each hourly check-in for a blocked fixer head with no hold silently costs one extra paginated REST request; operators reading the changelog will be surprised by it. The runtime verdict is still correct (`state: blocked`, `done: true`), so this is documentation precision, not a runtime defect. The same claim is also restated in workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/check_in_status.py:84-86 (the API-budget docstring was updated to say the comment read happens "before the label check"), so the changelog row should be brought in line.
